0022600213.text: The LA Clippers (2-7, 0-4 on the road) visit the Phoenix Suns (3-5, 3-2 at home) for their 10th game of the 2026-27 season, with LA 13th in the West and Phoenix 12th. Out for the Clippers are Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while Cam Christie is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder surgery), and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the Clippers winning the most recent meeting 117-93 in Phoenix on February 1, 2026.
